tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /ni gu'i khrid yig bsdus pa bzhugs/mkha' 'gro bye ba'i thugs kyi bcud/ /chos drug snying po'i gdams pa ste/ /grol lam zab mo bla na med/
༄༅/ /ni gu'i khrid yig bsdus pa bzhugs/mkha' 'gro bye ba'i thugs kyi bcud/ /chos drug snying po'i gdams pa ste/ /grol lam zab mo bla na med/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ni gu'i khrid yig bsdus pa bzhugs/mkha' 'gro bye ba'i thugs kyi bcud/ /chos drug snying po'i gdams pa ste/ /grol lam zab mo bla na med/ /thun mong min gang bri bar bya/ /

'dir rgyud sde lnga'i yang snying ni gu chos drug bsdus pa nyams len gnad du gril ba 'di la sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po la thun mong gi sngon 'gro dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro gnyis thun mong gi sngon 'gro skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro dag byed a'i stong ra'o/ / dang po ni/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i dbyings su seng ge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba'i steng du/ sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du ngo bo drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam pa rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po zhal cig /phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol te 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung*/ sku la mtshan dang dpe byed kyi spras shing*/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ bdag la dgyes pa'i zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan par bsam/ de la bdag rigs drug gi sems can thams cad skyabs zhu bar mos shing*/ blos ling bkal te skyid sdug ci byung rung bla ma rang mkhyen snyam pas/ 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad skyabs kun 'dus bla ma rin po che la skyabs su mchi ba lags so/ /zhes lan bdun sogs ci rigs bya/ mdun gyi bla ma rdo rje 'chang de 'od du ltem gyis bzhu ste rang la thim pas/ bla ma'i thugs dang rang gi sems dbyer med chu la chu bzhag pa lta bur gyur par bsam pa'i ngang de ka la had de mnyam par bzhag /sems bskyed ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bdag gi drin can gyi pha mar ma gyur pa med/ 'di rnams zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang la 'god par bya snyam pas/ ngag nas sems can thams cad kyi don du zung 'jug rdo rje'i 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i phyir du bdag gis zab lam ni gu chos drug nyams su blang bar bya'o/

/zhes lan gsum tsam bya/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro ni/ rang gi spyi bor drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma sku gzi mdangs dang ldan pa/ bdag la dadagyes pa'i zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa zhig bsgoms la/ ngag tu dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po che/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gi nad gdon thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ sdig sgrib thams cad 'dag par mdzad du gsol/ ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma 'od du zhu rang la thim/ klad pa gti mug gi rang bzhin can sbyangs te/ thod pa 'ja' 'od dkar po'i gur khyim lta bu/ de'i dbus su chos 'byung dkar po gru gsum pa rtsa ba phra ba mgrin par zug pa/ gdengs ka che ba gyen du bstan pa zur gcig mdzod pu dang*/ gnyis rna ltag g.yas g.yon du bstan pa/ de'i dbus su a dkar po 'od 'phro ba/ phyed chos 'byung gi steng du 'thon cing*/ phyed nang du chud pa'i tshad tsam rten med du lding ba la sems gtad de ci nus bsgom/ de nas a dkar po de las bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun byung*/ chos 'byung gang de lud nas lus kyi phyi nang thams cad gang*/ sdig sgrib thams cad phyir bdas te sgo dgu dang ba spu'i phug nas ded pa'i tshul gyis dud khu'am sol khu'i rnam par nag nur ru ru thon par bsam/ yang bdud rtsis lus kyi phyi na mar zhal zhal byung nas bkrus nas sa 'og thag ring por song bar bsam/ rang lus dkar la dwangs pa 'ja' dkar po lta bur bsam pa cung zad mnyam par gzhag /bde chen 'khor lo zla ba'i cha/ /skye med yig 'bru dam pa las/ /ye shes bdud rtsi rtag babs pas/ /sgrib pa'i dri ma kun bkrus so/ /༈ dngos gzhi la drug ste/ thabs lam bde drod rang 'bar/ sgyu lus chags sdang rang grol/ rmi lam nying 'khrul rang dag /'od gsal gti mug rang sangs/ 'pho ba ma sgom sangs rgyas/

bar do rgyal ba longs sku'o/ /dang po thabs lam la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ sngon 'gro lus gnad me'i stong ra ni/ rang gi spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang sku mdog dkar po zhig bsgoms la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po che/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gi lus la bde drod kyi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skye bar mdzad du gsol/ sems la bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skye bar mdzad du gsol/ bla ma 'od du zhu rang la thim/ rang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon cung zad bskum pas/ mi ro dkar po mgo g.yas su bstan pa'i snying ga mnan pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan/ rlon pa lnga bcu do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ sku lus kyi nang thams cad khong stong du bsam/ me'i gong bu dmar zhing tsha ba bya sgong tsam bzhi lte ba'i thad kyi rgyab mdun mkhal ma'i thad gnyis te bzhir bsgom/ de la dmigs bzhin du rlung ro lan gsum 'bud/ rlung dal bus nang du rngubs la/ lte ba'i 'og tu tshir gyis mnan/ lte ba cung zad bskor bas me gong rnams gcig la gcig 'thabs te/ /me stag dmar skyas lus kyi nang thams cad dmar chil ba dang tsha 'ur gyis gang bar bsam/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi gtum mo zas su za ba ni/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus na mar rtsa dbu ma sbom phra mda' snyug 'bring po tsam mas sna lte 'og sor bzhir zug pa/ yas sna tshang bug tu zug pa/ mtshan nyid bzhi ldan te/ drang ba/ srab pa/dwangs pa/ dmar ba ste mtshan nyid bzhi'o/ / de yang khong stod du gnas pa/ de'i g.yas su ro ma dmar po/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar mo/ de gnyis dbu ma las bun 'gros kyi phra ba mas sna gnyis dbu ma'i nang du cung zad chud cing*/

yas sna gnyis tshangs bug gi 'og thad du dbu ma la bkab pa'i tshul gyi mdun du gug nas cung zad gyes pa sna bug gnyis su zug pa dbu ma'i nang gi yas snar haṃ dkar po mgo bo thur bstan/ mas snar ram dmar po mgo gyen bstan/ bshang sgor rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam sngo skya rab tu g.yo ba rnams bsam/ /rlung ro dgu phrugs su bus/ /dal bus nang du rngubs la lte 'og tu mnan/ 'og rlung zad 'then la kha sbyor bzung bas lte ba'i raṃ las me phra zhing rno ba rim gyis 'bar ba spyi bo'i haṃ la phog pas thig le dkar po'i rgyun babs/ lte bar 'bar 'dzag skra shad 'dzings pa lta bu la sems gtad/ gsum pa rjes srid pa'i dbang zhu ba ni/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang bskyed pa'i bar gong bzhin/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa dpag tu med pa yid kyis sprul la phul bar bsam zhing*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po che la/ phyi me tog bdug spos/ nang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ gsal ba bde stong gi ye shes/ yang gsang de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa dam pa rnams 'bul lo/ /bzhes nas bdag la dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar po dpag tu med pa byung/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs smin mtshams yan chad gang*/ lus kyi dri ma dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ mgrin pa yan chad gang*/ ngag gi dri ma dag / gsang ba'i dbang thob/ snying ga yan chad gang*/ yid kyi dri ma dag /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ lus thams gang*/ bla ma yang 'od du zhu rang la thim/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma mtha' dag dag /dbang bzhi pa thob par bsams la cung zad mnyam par bzhag go /thig le 'bar 'dzag dga' bzhi'i 'gros/ / bde stong ye shes rmad byung che/ /bsod nams ye shes dbyer med pas/ /sangs rgyas lag rtser skad cig la'o/ /༈ gnyis pa sgyu lus ni/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du/

rang nyid dpal 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang zhing rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yon cung zad bskums pas 'jigs byed sngon po dang*/ g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo mnan pa/ de'i pang du yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ rang gi spyi bor seng ge chen po brgyad kyi btegs pa'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma zla ba brtsegs pa'i gdan la bla ma rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas dge 'dun mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad spyan drangs te bla ma la bstim/ de nas rigs drug sems can rnams yid mos gus gdung shugs drag pos gsol 'debs kyi sgra 'ur dir bar byed par bsam zhing*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po che/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag 'dzin blos thongs par mdzad du gsol/ dgos med rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ sgyu lus 'byongs par mdzad du gsol/ rmi lam 'byongs par mdzad du gsol/ 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub da lta nyid du/ myur ba nyid du/ 'dug sa 'di nyid du thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ bla ma 'od du zhu rang la thim/ rang gi lte ba'i thad kyi lus nang du chos 'byung dkar po gru gsum pa/ rtsa ba phra ba gsang gnas su zug pa/ gdengs ka che ba gyen du bstan pa/ zur gcig lte ba dang*/ gnyis mkhal khung gnyis kyi thad du zug pa/ de la sems cung zad gtad pas chos 'byung gi nang du 'gro drug sems can dpag tu med par byung bar bsam/

'di rnams snang ni snang*/ bden ni mi bden/ bden med sgyu ma lta bu yin/ rmi lam lta bu yin/ bden med la bden par bzung nas/ 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje/ 'di rnams 'khor ba las thar par bla ma mkhyen snyam pa bya/ rim gyi de rnams yal nas chos 'byung stong sang nge ba dang*/ de yang yal ba dang*/ ci yang mi bsam par mnyam par bzhag /snang stong sgyu ma'i rtsis zin pas/ gang shar thams cad lha sku yin/ /sgyu mar shes na sangs rgyas dang*/ /dmyal ba la yang khyad ci yod/ /༈ gsum pa rmi lam nying 'khrul rang dag la drug ste/ rmi lam bzung ba/ sbyang ba/ spel ba/ sprul pa/ yul snang ba gtan la dbab pa'o/ /dang po bzung ba ni/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang du bskyed pa yan chad sgyu lus kyi skabs bzhin las/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gi bdag 'dzin blos thongs par mdzad du gsol/ dgos med rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ rmi lam zin par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gso ba btab pas/ bla ma 'od du zhu rang la thim/ rang gi lus kyi nang du rtsa dbu ma kha dog dkar po sbom na lag ngar tsam/ phra na sba snyug tsam/ mas sna gsang gnas su zug cing*/ yas sna tshangs bug tu zug pa/ shel gyi ka ba btsugs pa lta bu/ de'i yas sna'i nang du haṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du lta ba/ mas sna'i nang du hūṃ dmar po mgo bo gyen du lta ba bsam/ spyi bo'i haṃ las thig le dkar po sran ma tsam cig chad snying gar babs/ gti mug dag /mas sna'i hūṃ las thig le dmar po sran ma tsam zhig chad/ snying gar sleb/ 'dod chags dag /de gnyis snying gar 'dzoms pas zhe sdang rang dag la song bar bsam/ rmi lam 'dun pa drag po'i ngang nas snying ga'i thad kyi dbu ma'i nang du thig le gnyis 'bros 'ded kyi tshul du g.yas skor du 'khor zhing*/ ji zhig na reg tsam reg tsam dang*/ de nas reg pas lus sems bde chil chil ba dang*/

mthar thig le gnyis gcig la gcig thim nas gtad med du yal ba la dmigs med du bzhag /'di rmi lam rang yin snyam 'dun pa drag po bya'o/ /thig le 'khor ba bum dbang*/ reg pa gsang dbang lus sems bde chil ba shes rab ye shes kyi dbang*/ mtha' yal ba dbang bzhi pa'i gnad dang 'brel ba yin/ gnyis pa rmi lam sbyang ba ni/ gsol 'debs skabs zin pa zhes pa'i tshab tu 'byongs par mdzad du gsol/ zer dgos la gzhan 'dra'o/ /rmi lam gyi 'dun pa drag pos gdong du dngos po ci yod la phar thal tshur thal du 'gro ba dang*/ gzhan yang nam mkha' la 'phur ba dang*/ sa 'og la 'dzul ba sogs ci dran dran gyis sbyong*/ 'jigs pa dang*/ skyug bro ba dang*/ ngo tsha ba dang*/ ya nga ba thams cad la thog brdzis kyi dmigs pa bya/ spel ba sogs lhag ma chos tshan bzhi po re zhig bzhag go /thabs kyi gsang ba'i 'khrul chen po/ /'dun pas skad cig nyid la yang*/ cho 'phrul dpag med a 'thas bral/ /'khor ba'i rgya mdud yud kyis grol/ /༈ bzhi pa 'od gsal gti mug rang sangs la/ 'od gsal bzung ba ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i spyi bor gdan bzhi rdzogs kyi steng du/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang rus rgyan stag lpags sogs dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po che/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag 'dzin= /dgos med= /'od gsal zin par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba 'debs/ lhag ma sngon 'gro sgyu lus dang 'dra/ rang lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma dkar po de'i snying ga'i thad du pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma bzhi pa/ de'i steng du rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang sku mdog dkar po tshon gang ba/ thugs kar thig le sran ma tsam dngul chu'i mdog lta bu 'od 'phro ba/ hūṃ gi 'od kyis bla ma gsal bar byas/ bla ma'i 'od kyis rang lus thams cad gsal bar byas shing*/ hūm̐ la sems gtad la mnyam par bzhag

go /gti mug na bun tshogs de rnams/ /'od gsal nam mkha'i dbyings su zhi/ khams gsum khyab pa'i nyi 'od 'dis/ /smra rgyu med pa'i don cig mthong*/ /༈ lnga pa 'pho ba ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i spyi bor bla ma sgom pa'i bar sgyu lus kyi skabs bzhin/ gsol 'debs ni/ bar dor sangs rgya bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'don pa spos la gzhan gong ltar gsol ba btab/ lus kyi nang du rtsa dbu ma dkar zhing dwangs pa sbom phra sba lcag tsam/ mas sna gsang gnas zug cing kha zum pa/ yas sna spyi bo'i tshangs bug rgya mthong kha phye ba ltar skya thal le ba yod pa la zug cing 'brel ba/ lte ba'i thad kyi dbu ma'i nang du chos 'byung dkar po shin tu gsal ba rtsa ba thur du zug pa/ gdengs ka gyen du bstan pa'i zur gcig lte ba dang*/ gnyis g.yas g.yon du bstan/ de'i dbus su a dkar po 'dar zhing g.yo ba 'phir la khad pa zhig bsam/ rlung ro lan gsum 'bud/ de nas nang du rngubs de nas lte 'og tu cung zad mnan/ 'og rlung drag tu 'then/ rang gi lto ba sgal tshigs la lan gsum gdab pas/ rlung gi shugs dag gis a de mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du dbu ma'i nang tshangs bug nas skya rgyang thon/ nam mkha' la yal gyis song bar bsam/ de ltar yang bdun tsam bya/ de rjes a de nam mkha' nas skya lam de spyi bor babs/ tshangs bug nas zhugs/ dbu ma'i nang gi chos 'byung du sleb/ lus bde chil byung zhing*/ a de brjid dang ldan par gyur/ de 'pho ba'i dmigs thun cig yin/ de nyid yang yang bsgom/ thun 'jog na tshangs bug kha zum par bsam/ btsan thabs 'pho ba'i gdams ngag 'dis/ /mtshams med byas pa'ang grol bar 'gyur/ /dbyings su 'pho ba 'di yis chog /'gro ba drug tu 'khor bas ci/ /༈ drug pa bar do ni/ gsol 'debs kyi sham bur longs sku thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'don/ rang gi mdun du chos 'byung sngon po/ chos 'byung de'i dbus su rang nyid phyin pas yi ge hūm̐ sngon por gyur/
de las 'od zer 'phros/ chos 'byung la phog pas/ rigs drug tu sngar skyes pa dang*/ da lta skyes pa'i lan chags sbyangs/ ma 'ongs pa'i skye sgo bkag

/hūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog tu gsal ba'i spyi bor bla ma bsgom/ bar do longs sku thob par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab/ gzugs su snang ba thams cad yi dam 'khor lo bde mchog tu bsgom/ sgra grags pa thams cad oṃ hriḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa la sogs pa yi dam gyi sngags su bsgom/ dran rig gi yul yid la shar ba thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur bden par grub pa cig kyang med par thag bcad nas/ chos 'byung gi nang gi g.yas zur du pho thams cad 'khor lo sdom par bsgom/ mo thams cad chos 'byung gi g.yon zur du rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bsgom/ de thams cad bar dor shes pa gal che'o/ /bar dor 'dun pas 'dzin pa ni/ /las dang po pa la ngo mtshar che/ /dag pa rab 'byams kho na la/ /srid pa'i las snang yod ma yin/ /gtum mo'i dmigs pa sgom na/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed stong ra rnams sngon du 'gro byas te bsgom/ sgyu lus rmi lam/ 'od gsal/ 'pho ba rnams la stong ra'i rjes su 'chi ba mi rtag pa'i skyo shas dung ba re bsgom pa yang gal che zhing*/ de mtshams dngos gzhi so so la 'jug /bar do la de'i tshab tu/ bar do dngos yin par 'dug ci rang drag /da ni ma 'khrul ba zhig byed dgos/ bar do rgyal ba longs sku'i gdams ngag bla mas gnang ba de sgom dgos snyam pas dngos gzhi 'jug /spyi babs chos drug kar mnyam len ma lcogs na/ rang gang mos pa re bsgoms pas chog /dper na gtum mo kho na la mos na skyabs sems stong ra sngon du 'gro bas/ lus gnad me'i stong ra rlung thengs gsum bzhi tsam bsgoms/ gtum mo zas su za ba ci nus nus bsgoms nas/ thun 'jog khar srid pa'i dbang zhu ba tshar cig byed pa yin/ de nyid thun bzhi la sogs par bya'o/ /gzhan rnams la'ang rigs 'gre'o/ chos gnyis gnyis gsum gsum tsam bsgoms na yang de yis rigs 'gre'o/ yongs rdzogs su sgom pa ni/

snga dro gtum mo/ nyin gung sgyu lus/ /dgong mo rmi lam/ /mtshan mo 'od gsal rnams bsgom/ 'pho ba bar do skabs su gang bab cig tu bsgom par bya'o/ /'di smras pa/ shin tu zab pa'i lam gyi mchog /kun las mchog kyang dga' ba'i tog /snying po mdo tsam sbyar ba 'dis/ /'gro kun byang chub mchog thob shog /ni gu chos drug gi snying po don mthil du bstan pa'i 'khrid tshul 'di ni/ rigs rus phun sum tshogs pa'i sa gzhir/ dad sogs dge ba'i sdong po rgyas pa'i skal bzang can ngag dbang blo ldan bzang mo'i gsung gis bskul nas/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas stag lung du sbyar ba'o// //maṅga laṃ// zhus dag/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ni gu'i khrid yig bsdus pa bzhugs/ - PAGE 320 -- PAGE 319 -- PAGE 315 -
